label: Higher at D1 after no reward, lowest after common-rewarded trials; slightly lower at GO/D2 after no reward.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_common == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_common == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (valid == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_common == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo * (prev_action == 1)
explanation: Timing dominates the raw reset gate value (high at D1/GO, low at D2, falling late in the episode). Beyond timing, the main driver is the reward input at D1: after an unrewarded trial r is about +0.06 higher than after a rewarded one, and a common-rewarded trial lowers it a further ~0.026 (rare-rewarded sits in between). At GO and D2 the sign flips weakly: no reward on the last trial lowers r by ~0.01-0.02. Belief, choice/state, the trial before and the ep_trial interaction add almost nothing. The invalid-D2 term (agent acted at D2) has a large weight but is rare, so it adds little R^2. The free fit gains only about 0.02 over the short form.

issues: The label's claim 'lowest after common-rewarded trials' is wrong. The D1 residual table shows a1 S1 r -0.046 (common), a2 S2 r -0.021 (common), a2 S1 r -0.023 (rare) and a1 S2 r +0.003 (rare). The two common-rewarded cells differ by 2x, and a2 S2 r is the same as the rare a2 S1 r. The real low point is a reward at S1, which is evidence that S1 is good. It is not about common transitions.

Misses on the recorded short form find the systematic error this causes. D1 after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by -0.025, and D1 after a2 S2 r is under-predicted by +0.012. Late-episode rewarded D1 windows (t96-99, a1 S1c) come out about 0.10 too high in the predictions.

The prev_common term is a stand-in. Replacing it with (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * belief (P(S1 good)) raises the test score from 0.658 to 0.707 with the same other two terms. The last_is('a1 S1 r') version scores 0.652, and the common version without the GO/D2 term scores 0.631.
Two claims hold up. The no-reward D1 raise (weight +0.054) is the main term (0.505 test on its own). The weak GO/D2 lowering after no reward (-0.012) is real (dropping it costs about 0.03).

A smaller error remains with the new form. D1 after a1 S2 r is under-predicted by +0.031 and D1 after a2 S2 r is over-predicted by -0.020, so belief does not capture everything at D1. The new form still reaches 0.707 against an all-observed reference of 0.69 and a ceiling of 0.74.
skeptic.revised_label: Higher at D1 after no reward; after reward, lower the more the belief favours S1; slightly lower at GO/D2 after no reward.
